The Aurora Quest is a new quest for the new Auroracrest tools added in the 2024 Christmas Event. It requires you to have the Icecrest tools from the Ice Golem Shop and combine them with Heart of Borealis on an altar in a secret cave, The tools will only combine during an aurora, however you can "prepare" them in advance by putting everything on the pedestal.

Guide for both of the Auroracrest tools:

Required items :

  • 2x Heart of Borealis
  • Icecrest Pickaxe
  • Icecrest Axe
  • Flamethower ( alternatively, 3 small bombs or one large bomb )
  • Grabbiest Grabber ( optional, reccomended. )

Finding the Shrine : The Aurora Shrine is located in the Icelands ( Informally called the Snowlands), It is reccomended to make your journey as soon as an aurora starts to avoid waiting for an aurora while in the shrine.

Heading to Snowdrift Station A and across the tram to Snowdrift Station B will place you close to the shrine already. Keeping right will take you to a sign that points toward the observatory, follow the icy path toward the ramp where it leads up to a higher point of the mountain, however, do not go up. Looking right and down the ramp, there is a drop that leads to a long, thick path where there is a breakable wall of ice. Jump down with your hearts and your explosive/flamethrower. Destroy the wall and walk through the cave.

Getting through the Cave : Thankfully, the cave isnt very hard to traverse. Walk through the cave, since there are no branching directions, you can just go with no directions needed, there will be a big daunting drop, dont worry though, you can drop down easily. You will be met with an icy floor with a few gaps present at this point of the cave, swim down and through the water, going forward. When you hit the wall, swim up toward the gaps in the icy floor above you and jump out, you are now in the Aurora Shrine.

Making the Tools : If the aurora is still happening, the path will glow green, pink, and blue, if they are transparent, the aurora is no longer happening and you cannot make the tools. Walk over the path and up the stairs to a large pedestal, drop your hearts and Icecrest tools onto the pedestal, and watch the magic. The tools cannot be created when there is no aurora present.
